== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The [[Arelius family|Arelius]] bloodline is a legendary lineage characterized by unique sensory abilities and significant historical influence. Members of this family possess a bloodline legacy that allows them to perceive the world through physical senses—such as sight, hearing, and smell—rather than relying on [[spiritual perception]]. This ability is described as beautiful and provides them with exceptional reaction speeds, coordination, and the capacity to see objects in ways others cannot. While some members use this power naturally, others must expend [[madra]] to activate it. Historically, [[Arelius family|House Arelius]] was a massive power with holdings across multiple continents and a legacy of leadership that included [[Monarchs]] and the [[Storm King]], [[Tiberian Arelius]]. The family's origins are linked to [[Ozmanthus Arelius]], a renowned [[Soulsmith]] whose personal crest became the family's crescent moon symbol. Despite their storied past and a history of maintaining peace with rivals like [[House Shen]], the clan has faced periods of poverty and near-[[destruction]]. The family is organized into branches, such as the [[Blackflame]] branch, and includes various ranks of power ranging from [[Underlord|Underlords]] to Archlord{{!}}Archlords. Their influence is represented by colors of dark blue, black, and white.}}
